study_info.title: A Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Trial Assessing the Effects of Rosiglitazone on Echocardiographic Function and Cardiac Status in Type 2 Diabetic Patients With New York Heart Association Functional Class I or II Heart Failure
study_info.authors: Henry J. Dargie, MBCHB,* Per R. Hildebrandt, MD,† Günter A. J. Riegger, MD,‡ John J. V. McMurray, MD,* Stephen O. McMorn, PHD,§ Jeremy N. Roberts, MSC, Andrew Zambanini, MRCP,§ John P. H. Wilding, DM¶
study_info.journal: Journal of the American College of Cardiology
study_info.study_design: 52-week, multicenter, double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled, parallel group study; randomization in a 1:1 ratio using a computer-generated fixed block size of 4
study_info.inclusion_criteria: Patients with T2DM and NYHA functional class I to II CHF, LVEF ≤45%, inadequate glycemic control at screening (fasting plasma glucose ≥126 mg/dl and ≤216 mg/dl), could be receiving any antidiabetes treatment except for a thiazolidinedione, insulin, or combination therapy with an insulin secretagogue and acarbose, all had to be treated with an angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitor or angiotensin receptor blocker, and patients with NYHA functional class II CHF had to be treated with a diuretic.
study_info.exclusion_criteria: Body mass index >35 kg/m², creatinine clearance <40 ml/min, significant hepatic disease, laboratory-confirmed anemia (hemoglobin <11 g/dl for men and <10 g/dl for women), LVEF on screening ECHO >45% + 6.5% when analyzed by the central ECHO reader.
study_info.dropout_reasons: Patients were withdrawn from the study if fasting plasma glucose was >270 mg/dl (15 mmol/l) during the first 16 weeks of treatment or >216 mg/dl (12 mmol/l) thereafter on 2 consecutive occasions. A similar proportion of patients withdrew from each treatment group because of adverse events.

minimal_units.subgroup: NYHA functional class I to II
minimal_units.intervention_details: Rosiglitazone (RSG) 4 to 8 mg daily, uptitrated to achieve target fasting plasma glucose <126 mg/dl, in addition to background antidiabetes therapy.
minimal_units.intervention_frequency: 4 mg once daily, uptitrated to 4 mg twice daily (8 mg total) as needed
minimal_units.adherence_to_intervention: At week 52, 56 patients (69%) in the RSG group were taking the maximal (8 mg) dose.

outcomes.outcome_unit: number of patients with increased CHF medication
outcomes.domain_match: Matches congestive heart failure domain (increased CHF medication as a proxy for worsening CHF)

minimal_units.subgroup: NYHA functional class I to II
minimal_units.control_details: Placebo (PLB) once daily, uptitrated to twice daily as needed, in addition to background antidiabetes therapy.

outcomes.outcome_unit: number of patients with increased CHF medication
outcomes.domain_match: Matches congestive heart failure domain (increased CHF medication as a proxy for worsening CHF).

meta_analysis_parameters.outcome_domain: all cause mortality；death from cardiovascular causes；myocardial infarction；non-fatal myocardial infarction；stroke；non-fatal stroke；congestive heart failure；peripheral vascular events；retinopathy；photocoagulation；visual deterioration or blindness；neuropathy；microalbuminuria；renal failure；amputation；severe hypoglycaemia
